TRADE COURT, CASE #6: PICK 5 FOR ANTONIO DAVIS 🎮🏀 We drafted a high schooler fifth overall, then traded him for a big man.

• 1999: we took Jonathan Bender at No. 5, then sent him to Indiana for Antonio Davis
• Davis, 2000-01: 13.7 PPG, 10.1 RPG and an All-Star spot
• We made the playoffs 3 years in a row
• Bender: knee injuries, 5.6 PPG over 237 games. Sports Illustrated ranked him No. 11 on its 20 biggest busts

facts.claim: On August 1, 1999, Antonio Davis was traded to the Toronto Raptors in exchange for the 5th pick of the 1999 NBA draft, high schooler Jonathan Bender (1 trade, 1 player each way). In the 2000-01 season Davis averaged 13.7 points and 10.1 rebounds and was an NBA All-Star. In 2002 the Raptors made the playoffs for the third year in a row (3 straight).

Jonathan Bender was selected 5th by the Toronto Raptors in the 1999 NBA draft and traded to the Indiana Pacers. Knee injuries limited him; he averaged 5.6 points in 237 career regular season games. In 2005 Sports Illustrated rated him #11 (No. 11) on its list of the 20 biggest busts in modern NBA draft history.
